en: Colorized image of an open‑air theatrical performance in front of a small stage built in the form of an ancient Greek temple, with a pediment and Greek key frieze. Red curtains frame the proscenium, and a single performer stands on stage. A large crowd watches from simple chairs and standing room; many men wear military-style caps or fezzes, suggesting an early‑20th‑century Mediterranean setting. At the bottom is a printed web address indicating the image comes from a Greek archive.
